metaTitle: Store a Sleeping Bag Without Losing Loft
description: Store a sleeping bag clean, dry and uncompressed to protect its loft: hang it or use a breathable sack, avoid attics, garages and RV bays.
directAnswer: Store the bag clean, dry and loose, hanging in a closet or in a large breathable sack in a cool, dry place. Never keep it in the stuff sack, plastic bins, attics, garages, car trunks or RV bays for long.
